name: pr_check
title: Check pull request
description: Check the arguments for create_pull_request, update_pull_request or merge_pull_request against the pecot rules before writing: the bundled PR template the body follows, the Issue the body closes, the base branch of a stacked branch, the title scope, unpushed or uncommitted work (create), and with merge, the state, head, stack position and merge method of the PR. Reads and writes nothing on GitHub; pass the results of the official reads in reads.

method.description: create before create_pull_request, update before update_pull_request, merge before merge_pull_request

owner.description: Owner of the repository of the PR

repo.description: Name of the repository of the PR

title.description: With create and update: title of the PR, as passed to the write tool

head.description: With create: branch of the PR (owner:branch for a branch of a fork)

base.description: With create and update: base branch of the PR

draft.description: With create: whether the PR is a draft

body.description: With create and update: body of the PR, as passed to the write tool

pullNumber.description: With update and merge: number of the PR

merge_method.description: With merge: merge method, as passed to merge_pull_request

expectedHeadSha.description: With merge: head commit of the PR the merge is for, as passed to merge_pull_request

template.description: Template the body follows: pecot-template://pr/<name> for a bundled one (its rules are checked); a replaced template's path or URL is accepted without checking the body

template_text.description: Text of a replaced template; the body is not checked against it

screenshot.description: With the bundled create template: reason to leave the image out of Summary

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that includes the target repository; when several do, the active one among them

reads.description: Results of the official GitHub MCP reads the check needs

pull_request.description: With update and merge: the result of pull_request_read with method get for the PR

pull_requests.description: The result of list_pull_requests (head owner:<branch>) for the branch the PR is stacked on: with create and update, the base recorded for the head (state all); with merge, the base of the PR (state open)

issue.description: With create and update: the result of issue_read with method get for the Issue in the head branch name
Issue the problem belongs to: a batch key or owner/repo/N (omitted when the check covers one target)

field.description: Name of the argument that breaks the rule (title, body, issue_fields.<name>, blocked_by.<i>, ...)

code.description: Kind of the problem (missing-section, extra-heading, cycle, ...)

message.description: What is wrong and how to fix it, with the expected value when there is one

candidates.description: Values that would be accepted (omitted when there is no fixed set)

problems.description: Rules the arguments break; when empty, the arguments can be passed to the write tool as they are

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
